title: Getting started
text: Parquet columnar storage file format optimised analytical workloads. Compared SAS files (row-based formats like CSV), Parquet offers: Reduced storage: Efficient compression significantly reduces disk space, especially large datasets. Faster queries: columnar layout speeds analytical queries need subset columns. Wide tool support: Parquet supported across data processing frameworks R, Python, beyond, making easy integrate modern workflows.

text: examples , simulate SAS register data two registers, kontakter diagnoser:
code: library(fastreg)  sas_dir <- fs::path_temp("sas-dir") kontakter_dir <- fs::path(sas_dir, "kontakter") diagnoser_dir <- fs::path(sas_dir, "diagnoser") fs::dir_create(kontakter_dir) fs::dir_create(diagnoser_dir)  kontakter_list <- simulate_register(   "kontakter",   c("", "1999_1", "1999_2", "2020"),   n = 1000 ) save_as_sas(kontakter_list, kontakter_dir)  diagnoser_list <- simulate_register(   "diagnoser",   c("2020", "2021"),   n = 1000 ) save_as_sas(diagnoser_list, diagnoser_dir) #> sas-dir #> ├── diagnoser #> │   ├── diagnoser_2020.sas7bdat #> │   └── diagnoser_2021.sas7bdat #> └── kontakter #>     ├── kontakter.sas7bdat #>     ├── kontakter_1999_1.sas7bdat #>     ├── kontakter_1999_2.sas7bdat #>     └── kontakter_2020.sas7bdat

title: Getting started
text: Use list_sas_files() find SAS files directory (subdirectories), use convert_register() convert . convert_register() expects files register based file names. convert_file(), output partitioned year, extracted file names: convert_register() reads files chunks (able handle larger--memory data), extracts 4-digit years filenames partitioning, lowercases column names. See ?convert_register details. Conversion scenarios example diagram shows four scenarios converting SAS register files register called bef: Single file → single Parquet file, partitioned year filename. Multiple files year → separate Parquet files partition. Identical rows deduplicated. Large file → split multiple Parquet files due rows chunk_size. File without year name → placed year=__HIVE_DEFAULT_PARTITION__ (Apache Hive default missing partitions).
